Google is reportedly working on a Pixel Laptop, and it could mark a huge shift from Chrome OS to Android. But is Android ready to power a true laptop experience? 🤔

In this video, we break down what this means for Google’s ecosystem, performance expectations, Gemini AI integration, and whether this could finally rival MacBooks and Windows laptops.
